name: Generalize nx cli output
summary: Replace console.log/error with pi-tui output paths: (1) scrollable area = Text component with array accumulator (push/shift, capped at N lines), setText(lines.join(newline)); (2) fixed footer = bottom-left overlay Text; (3) watch panel = Text below scroll area, hidden via setText('') which returns []. All console args stringify at boundary.

rawActions.name: Research console use in CLI: count calls, which files, arg types beyond strings
rawActions.summary: 140 calls total (121 log, 19 error). Two output paths in pi-tui: (1) scrollable content via Text.setText(string) — multi-line strings split by wrapTextWithAnsi; (2) fixed footer via bottom-* anchored overlays composited separately each render. Most console calls are scrollable output. Exceptions passed directly to console: nameforma.ts:190,196 console.error(err); repl.ts:39 console.error(msg, err); repl.ts:76 console.error(err.message||err); cli-action.ts:271 console.log(value) where value is (action as any)[field]. All must be stringified at the output boundary.

rawActions.name: Analyze pi-tui Text.setText() as the output boundary: all console output becomes String(value) fed to setText
rawActions.summary: Text.setText(string) accepts multi-line strings — internally splits via wrapTextWithAnsi. All console output converts to string (String(value) for any types, join newlines for multi-arg calls) and feeds into setText.

rawActions.name: nf --pi-tui-test: scrolling random word per second + current time in fixed bottom overlay, using pi-tui library
rawActions.summary: Spec confirmed wrong: setText(word) overwrites in place. Fix: accumulate words into growing string, setText(accumulated). Scrolling requires newLines.length to grow each render. TUI confirmed: scrollable=growing Text content, fixed footer=bottom-left overlay Text.
rawActions.statusNote: pi-tui test working, scrolling and fixed footer confirmed
